grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lentils, oil, vinegar, mustard, seeds and fresh produce are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Puy lentils, pumpkin seeds and watercress are everyday lines at Tesco at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a saucepan, frying pan, sieve and bowl, with simple simmering, toasting and slicing.

works.reason: 200g dry puy lentils with oranges, radishes, watercress and seeds makes a sensible lunch for four, and dressing the lentils warm gives them flavour.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers peeling three oranges, slicing the radishes and spring onions, toasting the seeds and making the dressing, and the 25-minute cook matches the lentil simmer.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the bay, parsley and seasoning, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A fresh, peppery mid-April salad with a good 200g of sliced radishes running through it suits the date, and the radishes are a main part of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The short, clear British English instructions are easy for a beginner to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, seeds, fruit and greens make a filling, wholesome lunch a family would happily eat again.
